idea.title: Pilot a project screenshot without changing every card
idea.summary: Added an optional screenshot preview to the shared project-card model, then populated it for Markab only. A real dashboard screenshot and conditional rendering let the visual treatment be evaluated without placeholders or changes to the other project cards.

context.goal: Test a screenshot preview on the Markab project card while preserving the existing Projects layout and other cards.
context.situation: The portfolio's three project cards were text-only, and the user wanted to evaluate a visual preview on Markab before extending the treatment elsewhere.
context.problem: No dashboard image existed in the portfolio assets; the deployed Markab URL redirected to login, while the Markab repository contained desktop and mobile dashboard screenshots in its documentation screenshots folder.
context.investigation: Inspected the local Markab and portfolio image assets, confirmed there was no dashboard screenshot among the app's brand images, and previewed the repository's dashboard desktop and mobile captures.
context.decision: Use the existing Markab documentation dashboard screenshot and make image and alt-text data optional so only the Markab card changes.
context.implementation: Copied the desktop dashboard screenshot unchanged to the portfolio's public images, added optional image fields to Project, and conditionally rendered a 16:10 linked preview before the card title.
context.result: The Markab card shows the preview linked to the live product; WhatsApp and Content OS retain their original layout. Desktop and mobile checks found no overflow, and the preview preserves the GitHub and Live Product actions.

learning_points: Optional presentation data can support a one-card design experiment without placeholders on every item.
Inspect available product imagery before creating or substituting a screenshot.
Check a screenshot preview at both desktop and mobile sizes for crop and legibility.
story_points: The public product URL led to a login screen rather than a dashboard screenshot.
A dashboard capture already existed in the product repository's documentation screenshots.
The shared project card conditionally renders only the Markab image and links it to the live product.
possible_angles: A small project-card image experiment can stay scoped to one project through optional data fields.
Find the real product screenshot before building a decorative substitute.
